summary.en: Salvadoran missiles and ground forces have attacked Haitian gang hideouts, destroying the Mawozo gang headquarters and killing about 20 gang members, while Haitian Prime Minister praised President Bukele for the strike. Haitian security forces have intensified operations, killing a gang leader and targeting other gang sites, and kidnappings in Port-au-Prince rose in the third quarter. The United Nations reported more than 1,000 people killed between July and September. The conflict produced 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Salvadoranske missiler og bakkestyrker har angrepet haitiske gjengskjul, ødelagt hovedkvarteret til Mawozo-gjengen og drept omtrent 20 gjengmedlemmer, mens Haitis statsminister roste president Bukele for angrepet. Haitiske sikkerhetsstyrker har intensivert operasjonene, drept en gjengleder og rettet inn mot andre gjengsteder, og kidnappinger i Port-au-Prince økte i tredje kvartal. FN rapporterte mer enn 1 000 personer drept mellom juli og september. Konflikten førte til 193 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
